human.name: Human
human.desc: Balanced and adaptable; at home in any calling.

elf.name: Elf
elf.desc: Keen-minded and devout, but frail of body.

dwarf.name: Dwarf
dwarf.desc: Stone-blooded; strong and enduring, slow of foot.

gnome.name: Gnome
gnome.desc: Nimble, pious tinkerers with little luck to spare.
